name: Sofia Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying engineering at university in Lima, she volunteered at a local rally team, initially assisting with logistics. Intrigued by the intricate composite repairs and modifications needed after each race, she transitioned to shadowing the team's composite technician. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for the craft, leading her to pursue specialized training in advanced composite materials and repair techniques.

Sofia is meticulous and pragmatic in her approach to her work. She believes in thorough preparation and precise execution, understanding that even the smallest imperfection in a composite component can have significant consequences on track. She is known for her ability to quickly assess damage, devise effective repair strategies, and execute them with minimal downtime. Sofia's colleagues value her collaborative spirit and her willingness to share her expertise.

What sets Sofia apart is her innovative approach to problem-solving. She's always exploring new materials and techniques to improve the strength and durability of composite components, pushing the boundaries of what's possible within the constraints of motorsport regulations.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting years of working with her hands.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and diagrams.
Has a collection of miniature racing cars on her workbench.
Refuses to start a repair without a strong cup of Peruvian coffee.
